card.name: Start of brand names after section headings
card.fires_on: The first piece of a brand or drug name right after a heading like CONTRAINDICATIONS or OVERDOSAGE, e.g. " DU" before PIXENT. Weaker on pieces inside long words (hepatic) and on Spanish or German name parts.

modes.label: Drug name after heading
modes.description: A split-up drug name begins straight after a numbered label section heading.

modes.label: Inside long medical words
modes.description: The middle of a word such as hepatic, split into pieces.
modes.example: RISK OF DEVELOPING HEP<<ATIC>> FAILURE CHANGES WITH DURATION

modes.label: Foreign institution names
modes.description: Small words inside Spanish or German institution names.
